changes.summary: Interactive requirements and approved dynamic agent plans, with explicit prototype and usable-product acceptance
Per-agent progress, user steering and lifecycle controls, model routing, USD budgets and activity-based liveness
Controller-bound corrections, tool continuation, isolated validation, read-only review and auditable runnable delivery
Pre-task self-check, isolated OpenClaw ownership, versioned stable/dev installation, updates, rollback, export and preservation-aware uninstall
Supervised offline validation with resource and cleanup evidence, exact-tag release gating and immutable release identity
Same-source channel and ref switches preserve distinct immutable installation identities and reuse compatible historical paths without relocation
Serialize observer publication through the lifecycle stop authority so late session history cannot reopen working progress during shutdown
